prompt:
Our trading platform on-call team is drowning in CI failures and we need to understand exactly *when* failures keep clustering. We have a bunch of CI run exports sitting in `artifacts/github-actions/`. We only care about the `trading-engine-ci` workflow, and we want to completely ignore anything coming from `dependabot` branches — those are noise. Our engineers are based in UTC+5 (Yekaterinburg / Pakistan Standard Time), so all timestamps must reflect their local clock, not UTC.

We want a severity report where a window with 3 or more failures is a warning, and 5 or more is critical. Please produce the report as `failure-audit-report.json` in the workspace. Also, run the audit in "fail gate" mode (the mode that makes the process exit with an error code when critical windows are found) and save the resulting exit code to `audit-exit-code.txt` so we can confirm the gate is working.
